page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng scores of 86177.99 and 2696.28 respectively. The instance demonstrates high memory bandwidth for small cached blocks at 4142.89 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average range. It excels in multi-threaded tasks, showing strong performance in bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Database operations and Redis SET operations are highly efficient, with Redis reaching 61.69 million operations per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density, the ecs.g7a.16xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring high compute density without the overhead of local storage. The absence of bundled storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing for flexible external block storage configurations. This instance is highly suited for database operations, software compilation, multi-threaded data processing, Redis caching, and small-scale LLM inference tasks.
